summary: Tested the coupon visibility/eligibility split, first-order-only logic, usage limits, category-subtotal math, server-side tamper-proofing (13 new pytest cases, all pass) plus full frontend flows: checkout Available-Coupons modal (open/apply/remove/Add-More/reason states, first-order hiding) and admin coupon form (category + first-order + usage limits, badges, delete). One HIGH-priority frontend race condition found: /coupons/available is fetched with subtotal=0 before the cart loads and the stale response wins, so eligible general (cart-wide) coupons (WELCOME50 min 299, SAVE10 min 499) are wrongly shown as 'Not eligible yet - Add Rs299 more to use' with NO Apply button on a Rs854 cart, making them unusable from the modal.

minor.issue: For non-category product coupons the discount is computed from the client-supplied `subtotal` (tampered subtotal=1000000 on SAVE10 returned discount 150 = max_discount cap). Order creation recomputes from the cart so no real money loss, but validate should derive subtotal server-side from the cart (like _cart_category_subtotal) so the displayed discount cannot be inflated.
`subtotal` is a query param taken from the client; general-coupon eligibility/shortfall depends entirely on it (root cause amplifier of the frontend race). Derive from cart server-side.

Performance: per-coupon awaits (_usage_counts = 2 count_documents per coupon, _cart_category_subtotal re-reads cart+products per coupon). With 15 coupons this is already ~40+ DB round trips per checkout render (x4 renders observed).

ui_bugs.issue: Admin coupon cards do not display the configured usage limit / per-customer limit (values persist correctly but are invisible after save)

integration_issues.issue: HIGH: coupons/available is called 4x on checkout mount, 3x with subtotal=0 (before cart.subtotal resolves) and once with the real 854; the subtotal=0 response is the one rendered. Result: eligible cart-wide coupons WELCOME50 (min 299) and SAVE10 (min 499) render as not-eligible with reason 'Add Rs299/Rs499 more to use' and only a disabled 'Not eligible yet' button on a Rs854 cart -> customer cannot apply a valid coupon from the modal. IT21GENMIN shortfall also shown as Rs99999 instead of Rs99145. Fix: skip the fetch until cart.subtotal > 0 and/or ignore stale responses (AbortController / request sequence guard), or better, drop the subtotal param and compute it server-side.

MEDIUM: availCoupons is only refetched when cart.subtotal changes, so after applying/removing a coupon the modal's eligibility/shortfall data is stale (e.g. stacking rules or newly-consumed per-customer limits are not reflected until reload).

LOW/spec: requirement (1) asked for ONLY an 'Available Coupons' button in cart/checkout, but the inline manual 'Coupon code' input + Apply button is still rendered above it. Confirm this is intentional.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Checkout.js coupons/available race - gate the fetch on cart.subtotal > 0 and discard stale responses; eligible general coupons currently show as not-eligible and cannot be applied from the modal.
Refetch availCoupons after apply/remove so modal states stay in sync.
Compute subtotal server-side (from cart) in /api/coupons/validate and /api/coupons/available instead of trusting the client value.
Optional: show usage limits on admin coupon cards; batch the per-coupon DB queries in /coupons/available.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.js line ~96: useEffect depends on [location, today, cart.subtotal] and fires multiple overlapping requests with no cancellation; last-resolved wins -> stale subtotal=0 data rendered (verified via network capture).
coupons.py validate_coupon: non-category branch uses payload.subtotal (client) while the category branch correctly derives from the cart - inconsistent trust model.
coupons.py available_coupons: N+1 DB queries per coupon (usage counts + cart category subtotal); consider aggregating usage counts once and caching the cart lookup.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (modal apply/remove/add-more/first-order-hiding/admin form all pass; general-coupon eligibility broken by stale-fetch race)

rca_of_the_issue: Checkout.js fires GET /coupons/available inside a useEffect keyed on cart.subtotal. On mount cart.subtotal is 0, and React re-renders trigger 3 duplicate requests with subtotal=0 before the cart API resolves; the final request uses the real subtotal (854) but the setAvailCoupons of a subtotal=0 response resolves last and overwrites the correct list. Because eligibility/reason/state for cart-wide coupons is computed server-side from that query param, all general coupons above Rs0 minimum render as state='almost' with an inaccurate shortfall and no Apply button. Reproduction: login customer@test.com, PIN 520003, cart = Rice 699 + Toor Dal 155, open /checkout -> View available coupons -> WELCOME50 shows 'Add Rs299 more to use' / 'Not eligible yet'.
